Proposed The API v4 surface the platform specifications define: discovery, per-tenant controller registration, instances on one flat root, commands and proposals, and statistics reads matching Nocturne's (maintainer decisions, 2026-10-26). Each operation names its listener and whether it is served in pull request #8857, specified only, or still open. See docs/30-design/platform/v4-surface-and-nocturne-2026-10-26.md. Rendered from specs/openapi/proposed/nightscout-v4.yaml at 595e4f392.
API docs by Redocly

Nightscout API v4 (proposed) (0.1.0-proposed)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: AGPL 3

Proposed, not released. The v4 surface exactly as the platform specifications define it (docs/30-design/platform/spec/, alignment main 6e6223f26), with the routes that cgm-remote-monitor draft PR #8857 serves at 3be98536 behind CONTROLLER_REGISTRATION (off by default). Nothing here is on cgm-remote-monitor dev. The current API is described beside it in specs/openapi/upstream/cgm-remote-monitor/api-v1.yaml and api-v3.yaml.

Every operation carries three extensions, also written at the top of its description:

  • x-status: in-pr-8857 (served by #8857 at 3be98536), specified (rules and conformance cases, or decided by the maintainer, and not served by cgm-remote-monitor), or open (defined elsewhere in this repository, with its path or placement undecided).
  • x-spec-rules: the rule and section ids the operation implements.
  • x-listener: the listener that serves it, from authority AU2 (decision D16): data is ns-api (devices, clients, viewers), tenant-admin is ns-tenant-admin (the tenant owner, a second bound socket inside ns-api), operator is ns-admin. Under TENANCY_MODE=single there is one listener and the owner's actions are taken there with API_SECRET (x-single). No v4 operation in the specifications is served on operator.

Paths and permission names are proposals, as the specifications say. Bodies are the JSON Schemas in specs/sync/, referenced rather than copied; the command and proposal bodies have no JSON Schema file yet and are written here from the member tables of commands §7.1.

The statistics operations follow the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-26 to match Nocturne's StatisticsController at 89dcaf1dd; their response shapes are read from Nocturne's models into statistics-v4.schema.json.

Operations the specifications describe without a path (typed record writes and reads, the plan operations, the owner's view of who acts for the person, the tenant-owner configuration surface, the operator's tenant lifecycle) are not listed here; they are in docs/30-design/platform/v4-surface-and-nocturne-2026-10-26.md as open.

Discovery

Unauthenticated, cacheable documents about the hub software (registration §2, §4). The same on every tenant host; never lists a tenant's registrations.

Read the hub capability document

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/index.js:136, :157). Listener: data, unauthenticated. Rules: registration §4, CM31.

What the hub reads and stores: grammar majors, interpreted members, horizons, type keywords, limits, the well-known catalogue, and, when offered, submit, instances and commands. A controller reads it at launch and after a controller release, never on a timer. #8857 serves no commands member, so a controller offers no hub command path.

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/.well-known/nightscout/sync

Read the well-known controller catalogue

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/index.js:137). Listener: data, unauthenticated. Rules: registration §2, §4 (wellKnown.catalogue).

The index of the well-known registrations the hub ships (generated from measurement), the shared slot list and the catalogue mappings for older controller versions.

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/.well-known/nightscout/controllers

Read one well-known registration

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/index.js:49, :138-140). Listener: data, unauthenticated. Rules: registration §2, §4 (wellKnown.kinds[].href).

The specifications give each kind an href; #8857 serves it at this path, with kindId one of loop, trio, androidaps.

Registrations

The product resource <submit.href>/<vendor>/<product>: a controller's registration, keyed by (vendor, product) within a tenant (registration §5).

Create or update a controller's registration

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/products.js:266). Listener: data. Credential: api:registrations:create; an update also needs the binding. Rules: registration §5.1–§5.4, §6, G1–G5; authority §3, §5, AU4.

If-None-Match: * creates, If-Match: <etag> updates; no precondition is 428. Checks run in order: authorisation (403), preconditions (428, 412), the owner's block (403 blocked-by-owner), the registration as a whole (422, 413), then each element. The outcome is accepted or partial (201 on create, 200 on update), and the reply names the definitionId the hub computed. A retry of stored content is a 200 no-op.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
vendor
required
string

The registration's metadata.vendor, percent-encoded.

product
required
string

The registration's metadata.product, percent-encoded.

header Parameters
If-None-Match
string

* to create; every write carries exactly one precondition.

Value: "*"
If-Match
string

The current etag; quoted or bare. Every write carries exactly one precondition.

Read a registration with its current element results

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/products.js:336; it requires api:registrations:create). Listener: data. Rules: registration §5.1, §5.4.

The stored registration with its element results as evaluated against the hub's current capabilities, its binding and credential kind. An element's result can change after a hub upgrade while the stored registration and its etag do not.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
vendor
required
string

The registration's metadata.vendor, percent-encoded.

product
required
string

The registration's metadata.product, percent-encoded.

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/api/v4/registrations/{vendor}/{product}

Retire a registration

Status: in PR #8857 for the controller (lib/registration/products.js:271); the owner's retire is served there as POST …/retire instead (see that operation). Listener: data for the bound controller; tenant-admin for the owner (registration §5.1, and registration-submit.schema.json request: "retire is DELETE"). Credential: the bound controller with api:registrations:delete; or the owner. Rules: registration §5.1, §5.5; authority §4.

Retiring sets the state to retired, changes the etag, and keeps the declaration, binding and stored data; namespaces stay claimed until the owner frees them. If-Match required.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
vendor
required
string

The registration's metadata.vendor, percent-encoded.

product
required
string

The registration's metadata.product, percent-encoded.

header Parameters
If-Match
string

The current etag; quoted or bare. Every write carries exactly one precondition.

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/api/v4/registrations/{vendor}/{product}

Definitions and instances

Content-addressed definitions and leased running copies of a product (registration §7–§9, decision D19).

Add a definition to a product, immutably

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/products.js:277). Listener: data. Credential: the credential the product is bound to, with api:registrations:create. Rules: registration §7; identity §2; D19.

If-None-Match: * only. The body's hash must equal the path id (422 definition-id-mismatch). The owner never adds one. Adding a definition never changes the product resource or its etag; an identical retry is a 200 no-op.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
vendor
required
string

The registration's metadata.vendor, percent-encoded.

product
required
string

The registration's metadata.product, percent-encoded.

definitionId
required
string (definitionId) ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$

The definition's content address (identity §2).

header Parameters
If-None-Match
string

* to create; every write carries exactly one precondition.

Value: "*"

Create, renew or change an instance

Status: specified. The flat path is the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-26 (registration §7, amendment); #8857 serves this operation today at the nested PUT /api/v4/registrations/{vendor}/{product}/instances/{instanceId} (lib/registration/products.js:283), a follow-up for that PR. Listener: data. Credential: any credential with api:registrations:create; an existing instance's binding to renew. Rules: registration §7–§10, §11; authority §3, §6; identity §2.

The body names the product (product: {vendor, product}), a stored definition of it, roles {channel, role, provenance} and labels. Each create or renewal sets leaseExpiresAt (capability instances.leaseSeconds). A role is refused per role (role-held, unknown-channel, not-a-command-channel, not-registration-owner for a device command sink, …), never the instance. The owner never writes an instance. The instance is looked up within the request's tenant, as every tenant resource is (CM6). A renewal naming a product other than the stored instance's is 422 invalid-instance (registration §7 amendment).

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
instanceId
required
string (instanceId) ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][...

A random lowercase UUID v4 the controller generates once per running copy (identity §2).

header Parameters
If-None-Match
string

* to create; every write carries exactly one precondition.

Value: "*"
If-Match
string

The current etag; quoted or bare. Every write carries exactly one precondition.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
apiVersion
required
any
Value: "nightscout.dev/sync/v1"
kind
required
any
Value: "ControllerInstance"
object

The product this instance is a copy of: the registration's metadata.vendor and metadata.product. Proposed with the flat instance path (maintainer, 2026-10-26): a hub serving /api/v4/instances/{instanceId} requires it on every PUT, refuses a request whose product is not registered (404) and a renewal naming another product than the stored instance's (422 invalid-instance). A hub that takes instances under the product resource reads the product from the path.

definitionId
required
string (definitionId) ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$

The definition this instance runs: one the hub stores for this (vendor, product), named by product or by the path, from a product PUT or a definition PUT. Otherwise the whole instance is rejected unknown-definition.

required
Array of objects (role)

The channel roles this instance claims. The response grants or refuses each; other roles are still granted when one is refused. Each (channel, role) is claimed once.

object (labels)

Rule 7: string keys to string values, which distinguish, select and filter instances. Provenance, never a label, decides what is therapy data. Labels carry no names, device names or serials. Limits are the capability document's instances.labels.

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/api/v4/instances/{instanceId}

Owner actions

The tenant owner's actions on registrations and instances (authority §4). Served on ns-tenant-admin; on single, on the one listener with API_SECRET. An owner action on the data listener with any other credential is 403 not-authorised.

The owner's listing of instances, overlaps and registrations

Status: specified at the flat instances root (maintainer, 2026-10-26); #8857 serves it at GET /api/v4/registrations/instances (lib/registration/products.js:295). Listener: tenant-admin under multi; on single, the one listener with API_SECRET (authority AU6). Rules: authority §4, §8, AU6; registration §8, §9.

Every instance with its roles, labels and liveness; the overlaps (channel, role, claimant, holder); registrations with boundTo, credentialKind and bindingEvent; slotNameObservations; observed aliases only with includeWithheld=true.

Authorizations:
tenantOwnerapiSecret
query Parameters
includeWithheld
boolean
Default: false

Include withheld members (observed aliases).

Responses

Tenant-owner listener ns-tenant-admin: a second bound socket inside ns-api on its own bind address (decided 2026-10-16); the address is not specified. On a single site this is the one listener, with API_SECRET.

https://{tenantAdmin}/api/v4/instances

Bind a registration to a named subject

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/products.js:325-331). Listener: tenant-admin; on single, API_SECRET. Rules: authority §3, §4, §6.

Binds to transferTo; drops device command-sink roles of instances that no longer match the binding, except roles granted by transfer-role.

Authorizations:
tenantOwnerapiSecret
path Parameters
vendor
required
string

The registration's metadata.vendor, percent-encoded.

product
required
string

The registration's metadata.product, percent-encoded.

header Parameters
If-Match
string

The current etag; quoted or bare. Every write carries exactly one precondition.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
required
object (binding)

What a registration is bound to (decision 4): the subject that created it, never its token, so a token rotated on the same subject changes nothing; or the shared secret, which any holder of it presents. A request from any other credential to update or retire the registration is refused 403 not-registration-owner. SPEC-REG-INSTANCE binds instances rather than (vendor, product); this shape leaves room for that.

Responses

Tenant-owner listener ns-tenant-admin: a second bound socket inside ns-api on its own bind address (decided 2026-10-16); the address is not specified. On a single site this is the one listener, with API_SECRET.

https://{tenantAdmin}/api/v4/registrations/{vendor}/{product}/transfer

Pin the version a site's default views show for one element

Status: in PR #8857 (lib/registration/products.js:319-323). Listener: tenant-admin; on single, API_SECRET. Rules: authority §4; registration §12.

Pins are a resource of their own per product with their own etag (If-None-Match: * for the first pin, If-Match after), so a pin never changes the product's etag. 422 unknown-version for a version no stored definition stores.

string

Commands

The command record (commands §4, §5, §7). The hub routes and records; it never decides whether a change is safe and never alters what was asked (D18).

Send a command to a channel

Status: specified, not served. Listener: data (commands §7.1 names no listener; AU2 puts clients on the data listener). Credential: api:commands:create. Rules: CM1–CM6, CM30, CM32; commands §2.

The hub checks only that the channel accepts commands, the routing, the expiry, the size and the sender's permission; it never checks a dose, a limit or the therapy state, and it never changes the payload (CM5). A re-send with the same requestId answers 200 with the first commandId.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
Request Body schema: application/json
required
channel
required
string
object (Product)
payload
required
any

Stored exactly as received (CM1, CM5).

expiresAt
required
string <date-time>
requestId
string
string or object (Initiator)

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

https://{site}/api/v4/commands

Cancel a command

Status: specified, not served. Listener: data. Credential: the sender, or the subject acting for the person (CM14). Rules: CM25, CM26, CM32.

A pending command becomes cancelled (200). One already fetched or acknowledged keeps its state with cancelRequested (202), and each fetch carries the cancel until the controller reports. A final command is 409 already-final.

subjectTokenapiSecret

  • 409

  • "cancelRequested": true
}

Status: specified, not served. Listener: data. Credential: the destination instance's bound subject; no command permission. Rules: CM7–CM9, CM32.

acknowledged, then succeeded, failed or refused, with the payload hash, a reason when refused or failed, and when enacted the identity of the record that shows the effect.

Fetch the commands waiting for an instance (the destination)

Status: specified, not served; the capability's commands.fetch template. Listener: data. Credential: the instance's own credential; a fetch naming an instance that is not the credential's own is refused. Rules: CM18, CM26, CM31, CM32.

Each waiting command is returned again by each fetch until the controller reports, with any carried cancels. A fetch-now signal on the socket carries nothing; this fetch is the path that always works.

subjectTokenapiSecret

required
string (instanceId) ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][...

A random lowercase UUID v4 the controller generates once per running copy (identity §2).

Approve a proposal, which sends its command

Status: specified, not served. Listener: data. Credential: api:commands:create; approving is sending. An agent's proposal is never approved by the subject that proposed it (403 self-approval). Rules: CM13–CM15, CM22, CM30, CM32.

The approval binds to the exact change by its payloadHash. The hub checks the proposal's state, the hash, the routing, the destination and the state version the proposal was based on.

subjectTokenapiSecret
path Parameters
proposalId
required
string

required
payloadHash
required
string
string or object (Initiator)

Responses

Data listener: ns-api under TENANCY_MODE=multi (the tenant is resolved from the host), or the one listener of a single site.

Statistics

Reads over stored glucose and treatment records. Maintainer, 2026-10-26: on v4 under statistics, matching Nocturne 89dcaf1dd's StatisticsController for hub compatibility (paths, parameters, response shapes, the tenant time-zone rule, the under-ten-readings rule and its read scopes). Response shapes are in statistics-v4.schema.json. What a shared contract should fix and what it leaves to each hub, and whether Nocturne's compute-over-a-posted-body actions join later, are open for discussion.

Extended glucose analytics for a date range

Status: specified by decision (maintainer, 2026-10-26: match Nocturne for hub compatibility); served by Nocturne at 89dcaf1dd (src/API/Nocturne.API/Controllers/V4/Analytics/StatisticsController.cs:464), not by cgm-remote-monitor. Listener: data. Credential: reports.read (Nocturne's scope rule).

Extended analytics (time in range, GMI, GRI, variability, clinical assessment), time-of-day averaged statistics, the contributing devices and time in the personal target range. Computed over the canonical glucose stream unless one device is named (StatisticsController.cs:486-490). Days and hours are bucketed on the tenant's time zone; without one, the figures that depend on a local day are withheld and timeZoneUnavailableReason says why. Client cache 60 s.

Authorizations:
subjectTokenapiSecret
query Parameters
startDate
required
string <date-time>

Start of the window (inclusive, UTC).

endDate
required
string <date-time>

End of the window (exclusive, UTC).

population
integer (DiabetesPopulation)

Population for the clinical target assessment; default Type1Adult. Bound by name or number.

patientDeviceId
string <uuid>

Restrict glucose to one patient device instead of the canonical stream across devices; boluses and carbs are not filtered.

Statistics for the last 1, 3, 7, 30 and 90 days

Status: specified by decision (maintainer, 2026-10-26: match Nocturne for hub compatibility); served by Nocturne at 89dcaf1dd (src/API/Nocturne.API/Controllers/V4/Analytics/StatisticsController.cs:806), not by cgm-remote-monitor. Listener: data. Credential: glucose.read or reports.read (Nocturne's scope rule).

Glucose analytics, treatment summary and insulin delivery per period; a period with fewer than ten readings carries no figures (tests/Unit/Nocturne.API.Tests/Controllers/V4/Analytics/StatisticsControllerAggregationTests.cs:75). Cached five minutes at the hub; each response is narrowed to the caller's categories (insulin and carb aggregates need reports.read or treatments.read; Authorization/AnalyticsReadScopeGuards.cs:314-331).
